name_en: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - crop insurance
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Crop insurance at a low price. If your crop is lost to floods, drought, storms, hail, pests or disease, you can get money back. You pay at most 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for yearly commercial or garden crops. The government pays the rest.

other: You must grow a notified crop in a notified area.
You need a land ownership certificate or a land tenure (lease) agreement.
Apply in time, usually within 2 weeks of the start of the sowing season.
You must not have got money for the same crop loss from anywhere else.
If you took a farm loan from a bank, cover is compulsory, but check that your bank has enrolled you.

documents: ID proof (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID / bank passbook with photo / Kisan photo book / NREGA job card)
Address proof (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID / electricity bill / bank passbook with photo)
Land records or land tenure agreement
Declaration about the crop sown or to be sown
how_to_apply: Go to the PMFBY website (pmfby.gov.in). Open 'Farmer Corner' and register as a guest farmer. Then log in with your mobile number and OTP, fill the form, upload documents and submit. Pay the premium online or later. You can also go to a CSC or bank branch. You must apply again each season.
where_to_apply: pmfby.gov.in, a Common Service Centre (CSC), or your bank branch
